description: Use when writing tests for Tauri 2 commands, mocking IPC calls, or setting up E2E test suites. Prevents untestable command handlers and stale mock state from missing clearMocks() between tests. Covers Rust unit testing, frontend IPC mocking with mockIPC/mockWindows, WebDriver E2E testing, and integration testing. Keywords: tauri testing, mockIPC, mockWindows, clearMocks, cargo test, E2E testing, WebDriver, Vitest.
